Build the invasiveness lookup with intervals

build_invasiveness_lookup.Rd

For every serotype in meta_clean, finds child and adult invasiveness estimates: from hard-coded substitutions, exact matches, serogroups or the overall mean, in that order of priority (see the comments in the code).

Usage

build_invasiveness_lookup(
  meta_clean,
  inv_children,
  inv_adults,
  serotype_substitutions,
  non_typeable
)

Arguments

meta_clean

Cleaned metadata, e.g. from clean_metadata().

inv_children, inv_adults

Invasiveness tables for children and adults, with columns Serotype, invasiveness, invasiveness_lower, invasiveness_upper.

serotype_substitutions

Named character vector: serotype = donor. These take priority over exact matches and serogroup averages.

non_typeable

Serotype labels that get no invasiveness estimate.

Value

One row per serotype, with v_child_* and v_adult_* columns.
